hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored phaseEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_phase BIT-FOR-BIT across the sector count k; it increases with k (finer angular resolution); and it lies below the 1/ln(2) normalization ceiling implied by NeuroKit2's base-2/natural-log convention.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: phaseEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_phase to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across k
